mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a clear 71 degrees near Fireman's Park. Looking ahead to tonight, keep your eyes on the sky at 10:22 PM to spot the space station, which will be visible for 4 minutes as it travels from the Cross Plains area toward the Oregon and Costco vicinity.

For city information, tune into the VHAT cable channel or visit the website for government meetings and community news. Also, remember that you can help the environment by composting yard waste and food scraps at the free Food Scrap Stop located in Badger Prairie County Park.

Today is a great day to visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or enjoy Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, plan on catching live music at the Concerts in the Park series at Century School Park.
In our weekly look at local service calls, on July 13, an officer responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for O-W-I.
Treat yourself to today's delicious Snickers Swirl flavor, available at Culver's until they close at 10 PM.
